messages:
Asha Patel: Quick check-in on site copy for the tri-mode launch. Need: final hero, three micro-CTAs, webinar landing + routing, and a lead payload that keeps CRM happy. Who volunteers?
Miguel Torres: I can own the launch cadence (blog + social + paid). Hero should sell operational guarantees not model laundry lists. Thinking: "Predictable inference for production apps" with an economics subhead.
Samira Chen: I drafted three hero variants in the doc (short + long). Variant A: "Predictable inference. One API. Any deployment." Variant B: "Ship LLM features with predictable latency and cost." Variant C: "Run LLM inference where you need it: hosted, dedicated, private." Need help picking final microcopy.
Jules Park: UI change: put the three CTAs inline under the hero so clicks map to deployment_interest cleanly. CTAs: "Start Hosted" / "Reserve Dedicated" / "Install Private" (shorter than earlier labels). I'll adjust layout so the secondary CTA doesn't get hidden on mobile.
Nina O'Connor: SEO + legal note: use "inference API" and "inference platform" across headings. Also add rel=canonical to /deployments and ensure meta description includes "predictable latency" and "SLA" where appropriate. Avoid "hosting" language.
Miguel Torres: Webinar plan (wk2): focus on benchmarks + migration playbook. Landing should collect: name, company, email, estimated monthly tokens, primary deployment interest (hosted|dedicated|private), and an optional notes field. We need routing rules for Sales vs Growth SDRs.
Samira Chen: Pseudocode for the landing webhook payload and routing rule (to add to the dev ticket):
```
payload = {"email": email, "company": company, "tokens_est": est_tokens, "deployment_interest": deployment_interest, "utm_source": utm_source, "lead_type": "webinar"}
if payload.tokens_est >= 15000 || payload.deployment_interest == "dedicated":
  route_to = "sales@redwood.com"
else:
  route_to = "growth-sdr@redwood.com"
// tag the lead with utm_campaign and original_cta for downstream analytics
```
Miguel Torres: Important: if CTA equals "Reserve Dedicated" always flag enterprise_interest=true. That should trigger a higher touch email sequence.
Jules Park: Microcopy suggestion for Dedicated card: "Reserved GPU pools + SLA-backed latency targets. For predictable production throughput, contact sales for capacity pricing." Tooltip: "Reserved capacity, predictable p99 latency."
Nina O'Connor: CRM mapping fields: lead_type (webinar|trial|enterprise), deployment_interest (hosted|dedicated|private), enterprise_interest (true|false), est_tokens (integer), lead_source (social|blog|webinar). Include these exact keys in webhook.
Samira Chen: Post-signup nurture flow (short): 1) Instant email: thank you + calendar link + quickstart + short benchmarks PDF. 2) 24h follow-up: migration playbook excerpt + invite to book a dedicated trial. 3) Day-before webinar: reminder + calendar + join link. If enterprise_interest=true, include a request-for-demo CTA and attach SSO context.
Asha Patel: KPI asks for webinar: registrants, live attend rate (target 40%), demo requests, and SQLs created by week+2. Miguel, add the social copy to the doc. Jules, finalize CTA labels and send a screenshot. Nina, add canonical + meta lines. Samira, drop the webhook snippet into the dev ticket.
Miguel Torres: Draft social timeline: Day 0 blog + X thread + 3 tweets; Day 3 benchmark teaser; Day 7 webinar push. Use the hero line "Predictable inference for production apps" as the baseline.
Samira Chen: I'll open the PR for the copy + email templates after we lock the hero. Tagging Asha and Nina for final review.
deploy-bot: Staging deploy scheduled Fri 16:00 UTC. Will include marketing pages if PRs merged by 15:30 UTC.
Asha Patel: Deadline: hero + CTAs + webhook snippet in dev ticket by Thu EOD so staging goes out on Friday. Ping if blocked.
